mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 5.0% and remains elevated for two consecutive months, it signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both housing starts (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in demand that signals an impending economic slowdown, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for the joint signal remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a monthly increase in the labor force (PAYEMS growth > 0.5%) signals rising wage pressures that prompt Fed tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE < 3.5% and PAYEMS grows > 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100.0 and remains below for two consecutive months, it signals a manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in consumer spending (RSAFS) over the past month signals strong household demand that supports corporate revenue growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when RSAFS increases, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 4.0%), a decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary easing to combat inflation, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of months when CPIAUCSL > 4.0% and FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and labor force participation (PAYEMS growth < 0.0%) indicates a labor market contraction where workers are exiting the workforce, signaling economic distress and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of months when both UNRATE declines and PAYEMS growth is negative, or Rank IC for the joint signal remains below 0.03.
